message.dtt.diary_unwritten: You can't read today's diary until after sunset.
message.depression.mental_fatigue.1: (You let out a quiet breath. You feel exhausted)
message.depression.mental_fatigue.2: (Weariness floods into your mind from every part of your body)
message.depression.mental_fatigue.3: My legs feel so heavy... I can't muster any strength...
message.depression.close_eyes.1: (Your consciousness and mind seem to be at war, and your eyelids won't stop trembling)
message.depression.close_eyes.2: So tired... my eyes won't listen to me...
hint.dtt.pet.1: (The way %s tilts its head makes you feel less alone)
hint.dtt.pet.2: Thanks for being here with me. I'm glad you're around.
hint.dtt.pet.3: With %s by your side, the world seems a little more bearable.
hint.dtt.reset_spawn_point: (At least for now, you can finally catch your breath)
hint.dtt.reset_spawn_point.1: I'll remember this place. No matter how far I go, I can always come back.
hint.dtt.reset_spawn_point.2: (You quickly realize that here, you can let your guard down)
hint.dtt.reset_spawn_point.3: (You exhale softly, and it fills you with determination)
hint.dtt.jukebox: (You close your eyes, feeling the music breathe with your heartbeat)
hint.dtt.jukebox.1: (If only cockroaches could play instruments too...)
hint.dtt.jukebox.2: (The notes wash over you like flowing water, easing your mood)
hint.dtt.jukebox.3: (You lose yourself in the music, forgetting your fatigue for a while)
hint.dtt.in_rain: (The rain soaks through your clothes, sending a chill through your body)
hint.dtt.in_rain.1: (Your clothes cling to your skin, and every step makes you colder)
hint.dtt.in_rain.2: (The cold rain saps your warmth, making you shiver uncontrollably)
hint.dtt.in_rain.3: So cold... I shouldn't have stayed outside...
hint.dtt.darkness: (The pitch-black darkness fills you with fear)
hint.dtt.darkness.1: (You can't see your own hand, yet you still pretend to be brave)
hint.dtt.darkness.3: (You gather your courage, only to find yourself trembling)
hint.dtt.ptsd_latent: I hope %s doesn't show up in my dreams tonight...
hint.dtt.ptsd_latent.1: (Even your thoughts are avoiding everything related to %s)
hint.dtt.ptsd_latent.2: (Whenever you think of %s ... unease wells up inside you)
hint.dtt.ptsd_latent.3: (Thinking about what happened with %s, your heart skips a beat)
hint.dtt.ptsd_form: Is %s watching me? No... that's just a memory...
hint.dtt.ptsd_form.1: (From now on, %1$s is no longer %1$s — it's a warning)
hint.dtt.ptsd_form.2: (You're afraid to see %s again. Just thinking about it makes you shudder)
hint.dtt.ptsd_form.3: %s has become your nightmare of fear...
hint.dtt.ptsd_extreme: I don't want to run into %s again... it hurts so much, so much, so much...
hint.dtt.ptsd_extreme.1: Breathing, heartbeat, tears — none of them listen to me anymore... I'm just a bystander, watching myself fall apart...
hint.dtt.ptsd_extreme.2: (The demon that %s brought will torment you endlessly..)
hint.dtt.ptsd_extreme.3: (The fear that %s brought will easily swallow you whole..)
hint.dtt.disperse_ptsd: Phew... maybe %s isn't as terrifying as I thought.
hint.dtt.disperse_ptsd.2: ( %s no longer fills you with fear. You've finally stepped out of the shadow)
hint.dtt.disperse_ptsd.3: (The memories of %s have finally become part of the past)
hint.dtt.remission_ptsd: (You faintly feel the courage to face %s)
hint.dtt.remission_ptsd.1: (Your fear of %s is slowly fading away)
hint.dtt.remission_ptsd.2: (You're starting to feel that %s isn't so scary after all)
hint.dtt.remission_ptsd.3: (The scar left by %s is slowly healing)
message.dtt.kill_entity_heal.positive: (Killing %s fills you with a rush of excitement)
mental.assessment.dtt.healthy: Mental health is in good condition. No concerns.
mental.assessment.dtt.mild_depression: Possible risk of depression. Monitor emotional changes and consider adjusting your routine.
mental.assessment.dtt.moderate_depressio: Depressive symptoms are noticeable. Keep a close eye on your emotional state and consider medication if needed.
mental.assessment.dtt.major_depression: Severe depressive state. Antidepressant treatment is recommended. Ensure your own safety.
mental.assessment.dtt.manic_phase: Mood is excessively elevated. Possible bipolar disorder. Combination medication therapy is recommended.
commands.dtt.trigger.close_eyes.not_depr: The target is not currently in a depressive state.
